body:
**Restructure 2026-10-17 (draft revision 3, not yet saved).** The user approved it after a red-team review of saved revision 2.

- 51 tickets in 1 sprint → 28 tickets in 4 sprints. Each sprint ends in one live game round (fail-soft probe, one fix batch, one confirming run).
- Work tickets never launch the game: compile, existing suites, and a few assertions for new pure logic. One review pass for the whole epic, before Sprint 1's live round.
- User decisions: the modder kit is Sprint 4. **Keyboard/mouse uses the new combat too**, with the same semantic actions as gamepad; the mouse no longer picks swing direction.
- Design now builds on reverse engineering of the installed v1.4.8 (native attack flags, the managed MeleeHitCallback hit pipeline, Harmony/MCM approval, native Controls remapping). The cut and deferred list is in the rationale.
- 30 tickets were removed: MMR-84–86, 88–92, 94, 95, 100–105, 107, 108, 111, 114, 116, 118, 121, 122, 124–126, 151–153. Their useful scope was folded into the remaining tickets.
